purpose: Teach: 短歌/防水/漁船/対岸/華人/バード/初演/見渡す

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、国語で、本気で、短歌、書く授業、絶対、あったよね、お前、覚えてる?本気で、難しかったよ、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Riku, remember that Japanese class where we had to write tanka? It was actually hard—like, seriously hard.
lines.style: Playful poke, testing whether he remembers. Bright opening. Quick pace on the setup, then a small dip of genuine admission at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。新しいスマホ、本気で、防水で、絶対、雨でも、平気だぜ、桜、お前、買い替え、考えてる?
lines.en: Yeah. I got a new phone that's waterproof—handles rain no problem. You thinking about upgrading yours, Sakura?
lines.style: Relaxed, conversational turn. Casual question buried in offhand enthusiasm. Slight lilt up at the end—not quite an ask, more like he's wondering aloud if she's thinking about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 港、本気で、絶対、漁船、いっぱい、見えるよね、リク、修学旅行、行ってみたいよね、本気で、絶対、楽しみ、本気、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: There are so many fishing boats you can see from the harbor, right? And the school trip—I really want to go. It's going to be amazing.
lines.style: Bright, animated, jumping between observations. Quick shifts in energy. The kind of chatter someone does when they're excited and don't want the conversation to stop. Genuine anticipation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 川の対岸、本気で、絶対、桜並木、綺麗だよな、桜、お前と、本気で、絶対、お花見、行きたいぜ、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: The cherry blossoms on the other side of the river are really beautiful. I'd love to go see them with you, Sakura. Seriously.
lines.style: Softer now. Quieter opening, like he's almost speaking to himself. Gentle admission on the river description, then a small lean-in on the invitation. Vulnerable underneath the casualness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地理の授業で、本気で、絶対、華人の歴史、勉強したよ、リク、お前、興味、出てきた?本気で、絶対、深い、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: We studied Chinese history in geography class—it was pretty in-depth. Did you get interested in it at all?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Not performing. Leaning forward with real interest in whether she thinks about the same things. Open-ended, waiting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 生物部で、本気で、絶対、バードウォッチング、行ったぜ、桜、お前も、興味、ある?本気で、絶対、楽しい、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: I went birdwatching with the biology club—it was fun. You interested in checking that out sometime?
lines.style: Warmth creeping in. A small smile in the voice. Not pushy—more like he's gently suggesting something he thinks she might like. Hopeful but low-key.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 演劇部、本気で、絶対、文化祭で、初演するんだ、リク、お前、応援、来てね、本気で、絶対、約束、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: My drama club's doing our debut performance at the cultural festival. Come cheer for us, okay? I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Brightness and ownership. She's making space for him in something that matters. No doubt. Small urgency underneath—this matters, and he's included.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 屋上から、本気で、絶対、街、見渡すと、本当に、気持ちいいんだぜ、桜、お前、一緒に、行こうな、本気で、絶対、約束、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: From the roof you can see the whole town—it's really great. Come up there with me sometime, yeah?
lines.style: Quiet warmth. Like he's sharing a secret place. Slow, deliberate delivery. The invitation is gentle but certain—not a question. Small breathiness, like honesty takes a little more air.
